about_the_game:
Build, Print, Conquer!

Build bases, set up money printers to print money, defend them from other players looking to take it over. Clear waves of zombies to discover resources, outdo your opponents, and reach the leaderboard for special rewards.

Get Exclusive Rewards

Be number one on the leaderboard to redeem rewards seen by the best.

Build and Secure

Install cash printers to make money, but don't get too complacent—there are other players who will try to steal from you. Build and defend your base to guard your loot and resources against incursions.

Steal and Conquer

Invade other players' bases and steal their cash printers to claim their profits. Outsmart your opponents and take control.

name: Heistland

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows® 7 SP1+, Windows® 8.1, or Windows® 10 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual-Core Processor or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent) or 1 GB dedicated VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, Keyboard, and Internet connection required for multiplayer gameplay.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10/11 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz Quad-Core Processor or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, Keyboard, and Internet connection required for multiplayer gameplay.
